mutations.name: a dry run calls the model
kills: shipped build options dry run calls no model and writes nothing, but reports the prompt size

mutations.name: the group filter is ignored
kills: shipped build options with a group, calls the model for that initiative only and lists the others unsummarized

mutations.name: the call cap is ignored
kills: shipped build options stops at 12 model calls a day and leaves later initiatives unsummarized

mutations.name: PR bodies are sent whole
kills: shipped build options cuts each PR body to 1 KB in the prompt

kills: shipped build arguments refuses a date that is not YYYY-MM-DD and a repeated flag
